digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch, orchestrator, and related LLM workflow modules
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap, blocking incremental changes needed by story 343b gap-5 (threading provider_provenance through finalize_verdict call sites)
gate_dispatch.py has only 1 line of headroom but contains 3 of the 5 finalize_verdict call sites that story 343b must modify, making the required minimal change physically unlandable

The plan-review recovery cluster in gate_dispatch.py (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, _collect_step_ids, _validate_gate_step_ids, _attach_plan_review_metrics, _recover_* functions) forms a cohesive call-graph seam that can be extracted to plan_review_recovery.py without test edits

The context-assembly cluster in orchestrator.py (assemble_cache, assemble_context_cache, _assemble_cache_key, assemble_context, _assemble_context_uncached) can be extracted to context_assembly.py, leaving finalize_verdict in orchestrator with sufficient headroom for 343b's parameter threading

Code review gate cluster in gate_dispatch.py cannot be extracted in this ticket because code_review_enabled is monkeypatched by string on the module object at 14 sites, and moving its internal caller would silently break all patches; this requires a separate design-change ticket
